fact: Health minister Esperance Luvindao said Namibia's health system continues to face fragmented information systems and paper-based records, and that health and civil registration systems often operated in silos.

At the policy launch the health minister said many systems still operate in isolation, giving the example that a system managing HIV services may not connect with patient records or pharmaceutical supply systems.
UCSF's NAMTAC page says PTracker automatically submits aggregated data to DHIS2 and the National Data Warehouse, and the warehouse combines data from Quantum EPMS, DHIS2 Core and DHIS2 Tracker.
UCSF's NAMTAC page says the national data warehouse takes data from three systems (Quantum EPMS, DHIS2 Core, DHIS2 Tracker), and an OpenHIM-based health information exchange was developed.
